sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT fp.posting_key) FROM fct_posting fp JOIN posting_skills ps_py ON fp.posting_key = ps_py.posting_key JOIN posting_skills ps_sql ON fp.posting_key = ps_sql.posting_key WHERE fp.is_open AND fp.remote_us AND fp.is_canonical_listing AND ps_py.skill = 'python' AND ps_sql.skill = 'sql'
